datasets.name: UAV images of Wenchuan County and Baoxing County
ImageNet library
datasets.verbatim: At present, there are many labeled natural image libraries. For example, the typical ImageNet library labeled by Stanford University, which contains millions of labeled images, includes more than 15 million high-resolution images with labels.

methods.name: TLOEL (landslide extraction method based on the TL model and object-oriented image analysis)
methods.summary: The TLOEL method integrates transfer learning (TL) and object-oriented image analysis. It uses multi-resolution segmentation to obtain image objects, generates regular image blocks from these objects, and uses a pre-trained TL model (based on the Decaf model) to extract features for landslide classification.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory data is not referenced or linked, and the custom TLOEL method code is not available.
